cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get the raffle accounts ready. Keep the cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes; I can't face explaining the broken lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take it home. I'll carry it to your car; you can hand it over tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll send the snapped key tonight so you can explain the lock while you count.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads accounts but assigns cashbox custody; A3 offers carrying to get B to store it at home; A5 supplies snapped-key evidence while making B explain and count.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 insecure office causes home storage; B4 treasurer count is expected follow-up; A5 key sent tonight fits tomorrow handover.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies a real security limitation and B4 realizes custody entails more responsibility.

heightening.evidence: B4 counting concern becomes A5 explicit count-plus-explanation duty supported by the relevant evidence.

specificity.evidence: A1 raffle cashbox, treasurer and broken lock make the burden and A avoidance concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 evidence delivery and B explanation/counting combine in one actionable sentence; no additional slogan of delegation.
